findings: The 2026-11-07 capture is the functional Terminal commercial off-the-shelf reader overview, with a separate route to accepting in person through the Dashboard App and setup routes for iPhone and Android.
The application needs to support automatic software updates often initiated when a reader connects to POS. A missed critical update can prevent processing.
The current summary states SDK exclusivity and certain payment blocking. Preserve the raw's compatibility wording and its often/can qualifiers.
substantive_changes: Relative to 2026-05-01, HK and MX are added to both lists and JP is added to Android. The 2026-11-07 overview lists 39 iPhone and 40 Android markets, with GI listed for Android alone. Counts describe these two table rows.
Table spacing is presentational. Existing Dashboard App, iPhone and Android setup, and Android MPoC Security Guidance links retain their destinations.
historical_claims_to_preserve: The prior raw filename ends in 2025 but its header dates the matched capture 2026-05-01. It contains 37 markets in each row, with JP on iPhone alone and GI on Android alone.

Both captures attribute completed iPhone MPoC Monolithic Solution certification to Apple and describe Stripe's Android MPoC evaluation as in progress at capture. Before the PCI SSC released MPoC, Stripe had completed security assessments directly with major payment networks for network requirements applicable to Stripe. Both also describe Stripe's PCI participation and advisory role.
conflicts: The mapped summary's JP exclusion for Android is historical. The Stripe company route at wiki/companies/stripe.md:454 also states 38 per platform and excludes JP for Android. Correct that route's summary and keep the older raw linked.

The undated Android Tap to Pay exclusion in wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal.md:318-330 and its linked companion wiki/sources/source-stripe-terminal-regional.md:21-26 needs dated qualification and routing. The 2026-04-24 regional capture (raw/stripe-terminal-regional-2025.md:2,66) lists Tap to Pay on iPhone for Japan and does not list Android there. The 2026-05-01 readers overview has the same Tap to Pay split, whereas the 2026-11-07 readers overview lists Japan on both platforms. Keep the 2026-04-24 setup guide's GA/preview classifications tied to that capture and avoid inferring November GA/preview or physical-reader eligibility. Flag the companion route for separate review.

findings: Add the 2026-11-07 raw and dated per-platform deltas, preserve the 2026-05-01 raw and dated history, and restore update and SDK wording.
conflicts: Correct the summary's undated JP exclusion for Android and categorical description of automatic update initiation and payment blocking.
source_assessments.reason: The reader overview's functional country table changes materially, while the guide's SDK, update and compliance wording remains substantively stable.

answers.Q1: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/tap-to-pay-readers, source-stripe-terminal-tap-to-pay-readers covers commercial off-the-shelf readers. The Dashboard App has an in-person acceptance route, and the overview names iOS, Android and React Native SDK compatibility (old raw lines 4-10 and new raw lines 5-11). The POS connection often prompts the reader to auto-update. The application needs to support that process, and a missed critical update can prevent the reader from processing payments (old raw lines 17-19 and new raw lines 18-20). Both captures say Apple completed iPhone MPoC Monolithic Solution certification and Stripe was undergoing Android MPoC evaluation, distinguish Stripe's earlier assessments with major networks before MPoC, and record Stripe's PCI roles (old raw lines 21-31 and new raw lines 22-32). The existing summary covers the same function but says SDK compatibility is exclusive and describes update initiation and blocking categorically. Its JP exclusion for Android reflects the older list (old raw lines 12-15), while the November table places JP on both platforms (new raw lines 13-16).
answers.Q2: For https://docs.stripe.com/terminal/tap-to-pay-readers, update source-stripe-terminal-tap-to-pay-readers because the 2026-11-07 table adds HK and MX to both platforms and JP to Android. GI remains Android-only and the sole difference in the November table, with 39 iPhone and 40 Android entries versus 37 per platform on 2026-05-01 (old raw lines 12-15 and new raw lines 13-16). Preserve the dated prior JP iPhone-only split even though the file is named 2025 (old raw lines 1-2 and new raw lines 1-3). The new overview lists availability without assigning GA or preview status or establishing account or device eligibility. Table formatting is presentational and the iPhone, Android, Dashboard App and MPoC Security Guidance links are stable navigation (old raw lines 8-15 and old raw line 27, new raw lines 9-16 and new raw line 28). Keep the update and platform-specific compliance qualifications (old raw lines 17-31 and new raw lines 18-32). Preserve both source-to-raw links and the Stripe index and company routes, with corrected company availability text. Add a reciprocal reader-overview route for stripe-terminal. Its Regional Integration Rules (wiki/concepts/stripe-terminal.md:318-330) and linked regional summary (wiki/sources/source-stripe-terminal-regional.md:21-26) still state the Android-in-Japan exclusion without date qualification. The regional capture dated 2026-04-24 lists Japan for iPhone and omits Android there (raw/stripe-terminal-regional-2025.md:2,66). Its listing is consistent with the 2026-05-01 readers overview (old raw lines 14-15), while the 2026-11-07 readers overview lists Japan for both (new raw lines 15-16). Flag the companion regional source for dated qualification and routing so a Japan Android query reaches the newer evidence. Keep the separate setup guide's platform/device guidance and its GA/preview classifications tied to 2026-04-24. The November reader overview does not establish GA/preview or physical-reader eligibility.
